narrativeVsNumbers: Growth is real (revenue compounded ~48% a year for 3 years; Q1 FY27 +41%), but guidance was missed two years running and by a widening gap — ₹4.4k cr guided vs ₹3.6k cr delivered in FY26.
The bigger divergence is cash: management promised positive OCF for FY26; the company burned ₹600 cr from operations while reporting ₹364 cr profit.
The language has shifted from absolute targets to '2× market growth' and rolling working-capital metrics — harder to hold them to.
Q1 FY27 PAT fell 25% YoY on 41% revenue growth: depreciation more than doubled (₹16→37 cr) as OSAT/PCB capacity came on, interest rose and the tax rate jumped to 36%.
bull: OSAT and PCB start contributing from Q3 FY27 (₹450–500 cr guided) with OSAT revenue visibility of ₹2,500 cr over 5 years per management.
Core growth is still 30–40%, and the capex has been largely equity-funded: debt/equity ~0.19× on a ₹4,700 cr net worth.
Stock is down ~48% in a year — the market already prices a lot of the credibility damage.
bear: Two consecutive years of missed guidance and a reversed cash-flow promise: management credibility is the core issue.
Receivables have ballooned (debtor days 154) and include annuity-style metering dues; further write-downs or discounting costs are possible.
Component inflation is squeezing gross margins (flagged on the Q1 FY27 call) just as depreciation from new capacity hits the P&L.
